bounded_source_flow_notes.name: registration, first-router selection and dispatch branches
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Registration inserts router tuples and route metadata; the first SmartRouter match replays routes and replaces match with a bound selected router before invalidating further add calls. HEAD recursively dispatches GET and strips the response body. One match invokes a handler directly; composed dispatch requires finalization. Async undefined results may use finalized c.res, which required correction.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: JSON validation and middleware response
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: With a matching JSON Content-Type, the validator reads cached text and parses JSON, awaits the application validator, short-circuits Response results, otherwise stores transformed input and awaits next. Malformed JSON raises HTTPException(400), handled through compose/onError. Context JSON stringifies and builds headers/status. This is a conditional source trace, not an executed POST.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: cache key, hit, miss and persistence
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Only GET/QUERY without Authorization proceeds. QUERY hashes selected representation headers and cloned body bytes within the ceiling; failures bypass. Cache hits return a Response before next. Misses run downstream and check status, Vary, Cache-Control and Set-Cookie before cloning and putting; wait=false requires an execution context. Tests use Map-backed cache substitutes, not provider persistence.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: SSG discovery, response conversion and lexical output guard
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: SSG executes fetch for metadata, expands parameters with app.request, runs response hooks, converts content and constructs a MIME-derived path. ensureWithinOutDir runs before mkdir/writeFile. Its segment/root checks are lexical; neither the interface nor guard establishes physical symlink containment. Module-global createdDirs matches the reported lifecycle concern.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: factory, plugin scope and ready-before-listen
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Factory builds routing, transport and SchemaController; Avvio has autostart=false and exposed register. Override checks metadata then returns parent or constructs scoped inheriting objects. Route hooks and schema compilers finalize at preReady. listenPromise awaits ready before server.listen and resolves the logged address.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: incoming request, parsing and validation through handler result
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Scoped Request/Reply run onRequest and optional preParsing before method-sensitive parsing. QUERY without Content-Type is a distinct 400 branch; invalid media type is 415. Raw buffering checks received/encoded limits and content-length. Parsed body then passes preValidation, validation and preHandler; a defined handler result is wrapped as thenable or sent. Synchronous custom value replacements and async pass/fail handling agree with the report.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: object serialization and outgoing hooks
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Optional preSerialization reaches serializer selection: reply serializer, route-context instance default, then schema serialize. Errors enter onError; success enters optional onSend and onSendEnd. No response bytes or serialization performance measured.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: shutdown and request deadline ownership
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Close marks state/routes draining, invokes preClose, conditionally destroys sockets and closes HTTP2 sessions. server.close is skipped for an unstarted custom serverFactory instance, warranting a wording correction. Deadline setup aborts and sends an error only if unsent; client closure clears the timer.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: HTTP creation and initialization before listening
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Factory constructs config/container, scans before loading instances and applying application providers, then returns a proxied NestApplication. The sample installs a global pipe and listens. listen initializes if necessary; init registers enabled body parsing, modules, routes and hooks before adapter.listen. Only source ordering established.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: cats authorization, parameter pipes, controller and memory state
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Admin metadata applies to POST; the sample guard requires externally supplied user roles and allows handlers with no role metadata. The execution closure runs guards before interceptors and applies pipes inside the handler closure. Authorized create appends to memory; GET returns that array. ValidationPipe skips DTO work for absent/ineligible metatypes, warranting correction of the unqualified description.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: TypeORM repository injection and write boundary
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Application config enables MySQL, autoloaded entities and synchronize. forFeature registers the repository token injected into UsersService; controller create passes DTO to service, which constructs User and calls save. Tests substitute vi.fn repository methods, so source delegation is supported but actual MySQL writes/schema synchronization are unverified.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: manifest request, action dispatch and finalization
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: FetchState receives constructor or ambient manifest and render options. handleRequest conditionally provides sessions, always cache, wraps actions/pages in middleware, finalizes providers and prepares response. Enabled action origin checks precede execution; action resolution parses input, binds context and serializes results. RPC returns a Response; form actions save results for page continuation. Finalizer rejection yields an error response.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: content file ingestion into scoped store
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Sync is queued; collection or loader schemas feed parseData and a scoped context. The file loader resolves against config.root, reads/parses supported formats, parses each entry before store.set and watches changes. No schema or filesystem behavior executed.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: store persistence and runtime content query
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Mutation schedules saving, serialized within the store instance. Sorted devalue data feeds fixed .tmp sibling and rename. Hashed chunk parts precede manifest commit and stale-file pruning. Runtime imports generated content and uses InMemorySource to retrieve values, resolve entry/image data and filter. Cross-process coordination and actual persistence unverified.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: build environment order and output boundary
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Builder runs setup then build, requires an adapter for server output, collects page data and calls viteBuild. Configured output is emptied unless disabled. Callback awaits prerender, optional SSR, then client with discovered sorted inputs. Config rejects outDir equality with root; no stronger path safety or actual output behavior established.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: standalone bootstrap, async initialization and root attachment
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Browser providers feed an app injector under a platform injector, with zoneless scheduling; bootstrap resolves environment and async app initializers, creates the component, attaches its view, ticks and calls listeners. Pending task removal is in finally. Static source trace only.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: documentation routing, content fetch/cache and HTML presentation
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Navigation requests emit into a previously installed transition stream. The route resolver obtains content through a normalized cached text request; component input binding bridges resolved data to DocsComponent, and DocViewer writes innerHTML then sets up controls. Corrected the setupNavigations call-order description.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: Algolia result selection and local history restoration
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Debounced query drives a resource, Algolia responses are parsed and deduplicated, clicking adds history, copied Map state is persisted as sorted JSON and restored in construction. Unexpected valid JSON shape remains an explicitly unexecuted hypothesis.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: HTTP subscription, interceptor ordering and Fetch response parsing
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Each subscription invokes handler; deduplicated functions form a registered-order chain ending in configured Fetch backend. Stability cleanup uses finalize; XSRF filters method/origin, Fetch buffers and parses then emits success/error, and unsubscription aborts pending work. No request executed.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: signal setter, tracked observer invalidation, and computation queue
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Accessor installs bidirectional Listener slots; setter evaluates updater and delegates to comparator-gated writeSignal. Invalidated observers enter pure/effect queues, then runUpdates drains pure queues through runTop and updateComputation. Transition commit paths inspected statically; no scheduling behavior executed.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: createStore batched path setter and per-property signal notifications
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: createStore wraps unwrapped state and batches updateArray/updatePath; setProperty updates/deletes state and emits property, existence, length and self-node signals. Unsafe traversal and merge-key guards inspected. Static semantics supported; tests not executed.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: resource promise completion and Suspense fallback counters
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Async load records active promise and pending/refreshing state; loadEnd requires promise identity before committing value/state/error and decrementing contexts. Suspense clears fallback when counter reaches zero. Test source contains pending, out-of-order and rejection assertions; no test result established.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: VNode factory, mount, recursive diff and commit
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Classic factory separates key and DOM refs and initializes VNode identity/tree fields. render stores a Fragment root on the DOM container, compares against prior VNodes or existing children and calls recursive diff. Class or function-backed component output is reconciled through diffChildren; commit applies refs before option hooks and lifecycle callbacks.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: component and hook state scheduling
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Partial or functional updates accumulate in nextState; mounted components enter a deduplicated dirty queue. Custom debounce or queueMicrotask schedules processing, sorted by VNode depth, which diffs/commits components. useState delegates to useReducer, compares Object.is and queues setState only on a changed value; before-render promotes pending hook values.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: hydration claims existing DOM and activates handlers
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Hydrate marks object VNodes and supplies existing DOM instead of prior root. DOM diff claims matching node types or creates missing nodes with mismatch callback; hydration skips ordinary prop writes but accepts function-valued props and synchronizes textarea values. The inspected test asserts node reuse/no matching-markup mutations and click activation; it was not executed.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: unmount and passive cleanup ordering
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Unmatched old children recurse through unmount, option callback, ref cleanup and lifecycle callback before clearing component ownership and DOM listeners. Hook unmount queues passive cleanup for after-paint, while layout cleanup is immediate; flush runs passive destroys before new effects. Tests assert pending effect cancellation and cleanup-before-create ordering only as intended behavior.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: SSR stream and serialized paused container
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: SSR resolves manifest/base, creates stream/container, sets server platform, renders and flushes. Container emits paused metadata and optional serialized root state; client reads qwik/state and chooses eager or proxy deserialization before marking resumed. Full event execution not independently traced.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: queued action submission and serialized invalidation result
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Client queues submissions behind pendingDispatch, writes currentAction, sends FormData or JSON, and decodes Qwik serialization. Handler parses body, validates, invokes QRL and emits optional loader hashes; task respects superseded actions and redirects. Only implementation ordering established, no HTTP action executed.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: Insights validation and statistical counter persistence
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Schema validation precedes OK response creation; following awaits resolve records and update or insert counters. exit marks routing aborted and returns rather than throwing. Source comments acknowledge avoiding transactions and missed updates. New-row delay bucket uses latencyBucket, matching labeled report hypothesis; neither DB outcome nor failure reproduced.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: app template generation and builder lifecycle
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Build prepares types, creates app, resolves application structure and templates, compiles changed contents into absolute/#build vfs entries, optionally schedules disk writes, invokes builder hooks/bundle, and calls close hook outside development. Static configured production path; no build run.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: buffered SSR request and browser hydration
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Adapter constructs event; per-request SSR context selects renderer. A registered server factory creates Vue/Nuxt app and applies plugins; buffered render obtains HTML, runs rendered/html hooks and creates response. Client selects SSR app, revives payload, runs plugins and creation/mount hooks. No runtime request or browser execution.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: sealed cookie creation, update and next-request restore
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Event/name cache deduplicates loads; absent or invalid seal with valid password configuration creates UUID session. Updates merge and seal versioned payload; serialization is checked before replacing only matching Set-Cookie. Next-request cookie restoration is asserted in synthetic Request test, not executed here.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: CLI scaffolding and filesystem write boundary
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: CLI entry passes argv and exits with runRemix result. Global options resolve context before lazy new command import; parsed target/app-name/force reach bootstrap. Target resolves against cwd, nonempty directory is rejected unless forced, recursive copy writes substituted template content and package metadata is rewritten. This is source ordering only; no scaffold files were created.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: template HTTP routing and streaming HTML response
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Template maps static/render middleware and controller into Node request listener. One-argument handler receives Web Request with separate construction/handler error paths. Router creates context and runs global middleware, matches specificity/methods including GET→HEAD bodyless fallback or 405, merges parameters and races dispatch with request abort. Home invokes per-request renderer, carrying URL/signal/frame/client resolvers into a byte stream and HTML Response. No browser activation or delivered response verified.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: OAuth transaction, persistent account resolution and session save
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Start generates random state/code verifier and saves transaction before redirect. Callback checks provider and exact state, clears transaction on success/failure and sanitizes return path. Demo resolves provider account/user via separately awaited database calls, rotates session ID and stores auth before redirect; enclosing signed-cookie session middleware saves after next and appends cookies as required. Memory backend deletes rotated IDs; cookie backend explicitly cannot revoke old session values. No live provider/database compatibility or exploit reproduced.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: legacy todo input, GraphQL mutation and Prisma persistence contract
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Component stores input then submits body to GraphQL mutation with optimistic record; matching SDL/service writes db.todo and cache update appends result. Schema defines SQLite model defaults. This is a legacy fixture source contract, no live write or current bootstrap compatibility established.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: Apollo credential headers and Yoga authentication context
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: With a token, middleware sends auth-provider/Bearer headers. Authentication prefers typed cookies, iterates decoders and supplies decoded identity to application getCurrentUser, enriching context only for truthy result. Separate useRequireAuth catches decode errors and still invokes handler, matching scoped risk claim; no authorization/provider outcome reproduced.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: job scheduling, conditional claim and dynamic execution boundary
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Scheduler builds name/path/args/runAt/queue/priority payload and persists JSON handler. Adapter orders candidates and conditionally locks/increments attempts before returning deserialized invocation. Worker awaits Executor, which loads compiled job and calls perform, marking success or error/failure. Worker timeout enforcement remains TODO. No database locking or job execution measured.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: Resolver transformation to browser RPC, Pages resolver execution, and authenticated session response
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Client loader replaces resolver imports with generated RPC clients; browser POST serializes params/meta and carries cookies through request/response hooks. Pages API middleware initializes session, the RPC handler invokes the selected resolver with res.blitzCtx, serializes output and writes session headers. The inspected toolkit-app sample login skips credential authentication and returns the full user; this is not generalized to generated applications. Essential session creation persists token hash and JSON data before setting cookies. Static source establishes intended wiring, not a running browser/server or database round trip.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: Existing session validation, CSRF and rolling renewal
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: getSession calls the kernel reader, which checks token version, configured storage lookup, SHA-256 token hash and expiry; CSRF applies except GET/OPTIONS/HEAD or an explicit dangerous override. Non-GET requests may renew on public-data change or expiry threshold. Authorization remains an explicit session/application policy operation, not an implicit property of RPC registration. Invalid kernels can fall back to anonymous sessions. No token validation, revocation or storage behavior was executed.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: Password-recovery token issuance and reset consumption
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Forgot-password validates and normalizes email, creates a four-hour token hash after deleting old tokens, passes plaintext token to the mailer and delays the absent-user branch. Reset validates before lookup, hashes token, deletes the found token before expiry check, updates password, deletes sessions and calls sample login. Separate awaits support a partial-state/concurrency hypothesis, not a reproduced failure. Production mail send explicitly throws. The non-existent-token test uses empty passwords failing the inspected minimum-length schema before lookup, so its rejection is not independent missing-token-branch coverage.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: App Router RPC handler divergence
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Generated GET RPC requests carry params/meta in URL search parameters and omit the body; the App Router allowed-GET branch awaits req.json() before its try and obtains payload from segment params. It invokes resolver with only {session}, unlike Pages res.blitzCtx. These are concrete source differences; bodyless GET failure and custom-context impact require runtime verification.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: HTTP application creation, server adapter, readiness and shutdown
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Ignitor creates web Application, sets shared service and runs taps. Init/boot/start callback resolves dependency server, boots it, wraps its handle in Node server, listens before readiness notifications and shutdown/error monitors. Server internals remain dependency-owned and were not inspected or executed.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: request macro, reserved request fields and validation options
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Provider macro constructs local RequestValidator with request context. Request assembly overlays params/headers/cookies after body fields; request reporter/message defaults apply only when caller override missing. Explicit data wins over assembly; compiled validator owns validate/tryValidate execution. Test source asserts required-field errors, inferred output and result tuples without execution.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: Ace lifecycle and controller scaffold output
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: BaseCommand hydrates then invokes lifecycle through container; controller prepare resolves actions/resource/API precedence, run creates entity and force/content options, Codemods builds stub, optionally replaces text from absolute/relative file, generates destination and logs skipped/success. Stub supplies controller path. Existing-file/variant/replacement tests only inspected; generator never run.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: AOT registration, first fetch and lazy route composition
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Dynamic registration stores handler/validators/hooks separately. AOT registration creates a route-local composeHandler closure whose result is cached; fetch installs a composed dispatcher running request hooks before static/dynamic routing. compile invokes adapter beforeCompile first. Generated Function execution is inspected source only, not exercised or performance-qualified.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: Dynamic request parsing, validation and error response
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Dynamic dispatch constructs context referencing shared store, permits early request hooks, finds route, parses non-GET/HEAD bodies, transforms, validates and resolves before handler execution. Standard Validate is awaited and value/issues unwrapped while synchronous Check fails closed for Promise results. Error handling can favor existing context.response; the skipped regression explicitly documents afterHandle response-validation error loss. This extra source observation is retained as a limitation, not a runtime result or an exhaustive correctness finding.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: Cookie verification, outgoing mutation and HTTP header persistence
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: parseCookie verifies configured signatures against one or rotated keys, decodes JSON-like values and creates proxy Cookie wrappers; reads retain incoming state and changes enter outgoing set.cookie. Signing then serialization crosses Set-Cookie header boundary. Dynamic selected signing requires schema membership and truthy values, while AOT selected signing omits that membership check. Key material was neither supplied nor read from credentials; inspected code and public test constants only. Signature security and cookie round trip were not executed.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: Native constant-response eligibility and Bun serving boundary
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Literal registration can request native promotion; substantive schemas/hooks prevent it, with listed lifecycle/error/afterResponse exceptions. App request hooks, trace and higher-order wrappers prevent native route assembly. Bun listen compiles and invokes Bun.serve before start hooks/callback; no listener or runtime created here. Regression assertions inspect route table promotion and registration hook counts, not passing execution in this task.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: File-range response mapping
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Blob/File mapping delegates to range parsing, suffix/open/bounded calculations and clamping; invalid offsets return416 and valid slices return206 with range/length headers. Public file(path) passes caller path to runtime file APIs; this constructor supplies no root policy. Tests assert only the first requested range. No files served and no request-derived filesystem policy tested.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: middleware registration and request-local dispatch
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Application stores ordered handlers and application-local prototypes. callback composes them and creates linked request wrappers plus fresh state, optionally inside AsyncLocalStorage, then starts middleware with default 404 and completion hook. Middleware cascade is delegated to external koa-compose; local test source asserts [1,2,3,4], not a passing result.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: response body metadata, serialization and stream ownership
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: ctx.body delegates to metadata setter; object bodies select JSON and responder calculates byte length and ends response. HEAD/empty-status branches suppress body; stream values pipeline to res with error forwarding. Cleanup preserves stream wrappers, except non-stream replacements normally destroy old stream; JSON-typed null branch returns before that cleanup, prompting bounded correction.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: thrown HTTP error to scoped default error response
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: ctx.throw constructs error and middleware rejection reaches ctx.onerror. Handler emits app error event before deciding whether headers can change; unsent response clears headers, applies err.headers, validates status and sends exposed or generic text. Source tests cover header reset and flushed-header case; no response executed.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: Admin create mutation, access, hooks and Prisma persistence
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Client invalid fields stop submit; serialized data becomes GraphQL variables. Generated create resolver checks operation/list/field access, resolves inputs, runs field then list resolve hooks, validates, transforms for Prisma, invokes before/create/after stages and navigates on success. This is source call order, not a browser or database execution.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: password authentication and subsequent session hydration
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Identity/secret mutation uses privileged lookup; missing password simulates hashing, valid comparison starts session and returns token. Request context decodes Bearer/cookie via strategy, auth wrapper hydrates selected user fields with privileged query, missing token/user/errors result in no session. Random default session secret and direct Prisma privilege are observations or bounded hypotheses, not vulnerabilities.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: file input resolution and post-write cleanup
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Configured field input resolver awaits storage put and returns counted metadata before validation/Prisma persistence. On update/delete afterOperation removes old differing filename. In-memory tests assert bytes/metadata/replacement/delete, without real storage execution. Failed persistence leaving new storage object is explicitly an unexecuted hypothesis.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: production server construction and optional Admin UI
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Start imports configuration/system, returns early for no-server, imports Prisma module and connects before Express/Apollo creation, optionally prepares Next/Admin UI and then listens. HTTP parsing attaches a request-specific session context; no server started here.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: ordered configuration transformation and backend adapter initialization
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: buildConfig sorts plugin order, awaits transformations, validates/initializes storage adapters and delegates sanitization. BasePayload then binds database/KV, optionally initializes/connects DB and selects configured/default email adapter. Sanitization internals and whole startup cache not independently traced.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: matched REST creation through access gate and MongoDB persistence
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Endpoint matching injects slug and invokes wrapped handler. createHandler supplies req.data; create operation conditionally starts transaction/access check, generates/uploads files and branches auth registration vs db.create. Mongo transforms, applies session and calls Model.create; shared operation commits conditionally and catch removes temp files/rolls back. Hook/version internals and actual stored result not executed.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: password authentication, session transaction and cookie response
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Identity normalized; login looks up non-trashed user, checks permission and authenticates. Failed password updates attempts when enabled; unverified user rejected. Success starts remaining transaction, adds session, attempts conditional hash migration, signs JWT, applies read access and commits. bounded_source_flow_notes.name: REST collection create, authentication and document persistence

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: Hash graph scheduling command execution and completion
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Hash key contains selected files/env/dependency/output/command semantics; strict process environment projects pass-through and hashed variables while loose passes start environment. Engine concurrency waits on callbacks; dependent stop skips subgraph, all-task stop cancels scheduling, dropped callback defaults success. Command provider first match wins and error propagates, overrides can replace or opt out; cache hit avoids spawning, fetch errors log and run continues. Callback precedes cache save; only successful Run outcome saves. Manager shutdown is separate from scheduling signal.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: Task cache output collection archive restoration and signing
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Output watcher can classify unchanged files already on disk as local hit without fetch. Otherwise restore fetches whole archive, not filtered output globs. Save expands glob paths, follows only internal symlink output roots, isolates managed peer logs and enforces repository containment. FS cache archive finish precedes sidecars. Remote signing, when configured, verifies before extraction; local miss/error falls through remote and remote errors may become miss. Archive restore is entry-wise rather than an asserted transaction; Unix special permission bits are stripped.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: Login persistence and remote credential recovery
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Standard login returns without writing for Existing token; Vercel device flow discovers/request/polls then gets user. Returned access/refresh/absolute expiry route by vca_ prefix to user auth storage and alternate storage is cleared through secret-write API. Remote token recovery serializes and retries replacement, disables remote for failed recovery. Only implementation was read, no real credential files/provider calls.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: Local GraphQL request host gate and bounded tests
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Server binds loopback and applies Host middleware to GET GraphiQL/POST GraphQL; missing/invalid/unlisted hosts fail forbidden. Existing tests call GraphiQL response and hostname helpers rather than a live network stack. This establishes source intent and limited assertion targets, not deployment/browser/DNS-rebinding qualification.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: API extraction and local versus production report success
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Run action loads/discovers prepared config; extends normalize relative paths before merge/default/schema validation. Compiler program feeds Collector, documentation/validation enhancement and model generation, then enabled model/reports/rollups. Actual report persists before expected comparison. Local mode can update expected report and ignores warnings in success; production warnings fail. Missing local report folder emits error. No extraction performed.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: API models to generated Markdown and output-folder replacement
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: CLI action reads matching API JSON into ApiModel and handles inheritDoc references. Generator optionally loads executable plugin, empties configured output directory, emits generated Markdown, permits pre-write content callback and finishes plugin. Source documents arbitrary output argument deletion; no folder was emptied and snapshot emitter test does not qualify that path.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: Explorer graph loading, Redux bookmark persistence and file-route boundary
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Initialization precedes cwd change; Express installs JSON/CORS and serves YAML-derived serialized graph. Browser fetch/deserialization dispatches entries and hydrates bookmark IDs, with reducers updating localStorage. Request-derived projectPath interpolates into package.json paths without shown containment/auth checks. package-spec optionally executes pnpmfile worker and disposes in finally. Traversal exploitability remains untested hypothesis; no server/browser started.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: ESM CLI bootstrap lazy dispatch and options
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Executable optionally enables compile cache then imports package; index parses without automatic run, enables TTY guidance for add/publish and awaits command. cac actions normalize arrays/scalars/aliases and dynamically import handlers; output fallback reads configured variable names in source only. ExitError controls code. No CLI was executed.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: Version command validation and release stabilization
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Command discovers packages and config, validates ignore conflicts/unknown/skipped dependents, reads intent and prerelease state, rejects snapshot/pre conflict and absent intent, then assembles and applies plan. Assembly validates unknown or mixed skipped intent, merges max release type and contributing IDs, repeatedly propagates dependents/fixed/linked changes until stable and computes final versions. Dev-only dependency branch uses none; file/link and symbolic workspace ranges retain exceptions. Fixed/linked helper internals are not exhaustively audited.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: Application persistence changelog plugin and prerelease migration
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Application resolves and invokes configured executable changelog generator before package writes. Manifests and changelogs write sequentially, formatter follows and consumed intent is removed or moved to pre with skipped packages retained; root dependency ranges also update. No rollback shown in this sequence. readPreState parses unchecked structure and migrates legacy files via rename/write, so read-named planning/status APIs are not asserted pure. CLI optional staging/commit happens after application.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: Registry plan and packed artifact handoff
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Registry info queues select unpublished versions and access/tag; private tag entries and dependency chunks exclude dev edges. Shared bounds are 40 info and 10 publish jobs. Pack delegates native manager packaging and computes sha256 on returned tarballs before writing versioned plan. Supplied plan validates only outer plan/version; publish resolves metadata paths without checking recorded digest. Registry identity is intentionally omitted, requiring matching planning/publishing configuration. No registry contacted or tarball generated.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: Publishing sequential bulk OTP and partial outcome
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Dependency chunks execute in order with bounded work inside chunk. TTY/no OTP initially probes sequentially; noninteractive success unlocks bulk mode. Recoverable 2FA failures reset OTP and can return to interactive then bulk; nonTTY or hard failures terminate later chunks. Successful publications and tag-only entries are tagged before eventual failure exit. npm adapter delegates lifecycle commands and clears OTP variables while inheriting other environment. Tests simulate command/auth results, not actual registry authentication.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: Git tag reporting and older release-utils parsing
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Git tag helper returns exitCode success boolean, but createGitTags ignores false and appends NDJSON/records newTags. Reporter awaits stream finish on disposal, which does not prove actual Git success. Current formatting uses Created git tags whereas release-utils searches New tag and performs pull/push; compatibility failures remain unexecuted hypotheses. None of these helpers was invoked.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: Eligibility and dry-run lifecycle gates
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Unknown CI forces dry-run unless noCi, PRs skip unless noCi, branch selection/authentication can stop release. Branch/tag/note fetch and push-dry-run auth still happen under dry-run; wrapper allows analysis/verification/notes but skips mutating lifecycle functions.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: New-version publication and preparation commit refresh
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Commit analysis and version/range validation precede notes and prepare. Preparation HEAD changes regenerate notes for next step. Tag/channel note and pushes precede sequential publish/success hooks. Failure handler notification/logging does not roll back those operations; partial publication remains a source-based hypothesis.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: Promotion of existing higher-branch release to channel
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Higher non-prerelease channel intersection selects eligible version and checks maintenance merge range. Core resolves heads, notes/commits, updates Git channel notes, pushes, invokes addChannel/success before new analysis. No new relevant analysis can return releases-only object, unlike declared Result required fields.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: affected selection and transform reuse
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Changed paths become related sources. Force triggers/config/setup/environment changes broaden selection, snapshots directly include owning spec, and static mock-aware graph walks narrow it. Existing execution-environment transforms are reused; per-graph module promises deduplicate transforms and bounded concurrency reduces peak demand. node_modules is excluded and transform failures are treated affected. Selection does not prove omitted tests cannot fail.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: coordinator scheduling to collection and suite execution
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Coordinator initializes reporters/coverage, selects/preparses specs, populates stats, creates pool on demand and initializes global setup. Sequencer shards/sorts; workers concurrently prepare runner/environment/coverage, reset modules only for isolate, collect setup before test import then execute. Results cache stores scheduling metadata; coverage/reporter finalization is separate.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: snapshot matching, file-suite finalization and storage
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: File suite initializes per-file snapshot state; absent structured reader content executes as JavaScript. Match delegates to state, finish packs/saves and reports summary RPC; external persistence avoids identical writes, while raw path can be absolute. CI missing-snapshot test asserts failure versus non-CI creation. No snapshot evaluated or written.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: nonisolated runner retention and measured-startup instrumentation
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: A completed nonisolated task retains runner only if not terminated, memory limit not reached and next nonisolated task compatible. Reconfiguration matches worker/project and environment or worker canReuse. Isolated tasks cannot share runners and reset evaluated modules. Startup time/workersSpawned instrumentation exists, but no timings collected; reducing isolation can retain module state despite restoreAllMocks/resetConfig.

testing_speed_source_notes.fact: Static dependency selection accounts for configs/setup/environments/snapshots and hoisted mocks; transform results are reused and transform concurrency bounded. Dependencies under node_modules are excluded; untracked runtime inputs require separate verification strategy.

Nonisolated compatible worker/project/environment tasks can share runner, subject to queue and memory state. isolate resets module/mocker state and prohibits sharing; startup instrumentation separates potential spawn cost. Reuse speed and state-leak risk unmeasured.
Cache records duration/failure for ordering; default sort prioritizes isolated, unknown/larger, failed and longer files. It is not a correctness certificate or a pass-result skip cache.

Assertion-count checks apply when declared or requireAssertions enabled; no assertion count proves relevance/completeness. Scoped fixture suite skips on rolldownVersion, root typecheck omits test trees, and helper defaults cache off/one worker/watch off differ from production workloads.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: In-process protocol dispatch validation and cancellation
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Initialization connects client and server synchronously then switches to setImmediate. Commands track callbacks and metadata, reject preaborted signals, and send abort IDs for cancellation. Dispatcher validates params/metadata/method and result, invokes bounded progress with before/after hooks under separate three-second controllers, serializes errors and deletes active controllers. Protocol validation is not a sandbox for the powerful tool methods.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: Test selection and worker reuse boundary
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Location and positive test-list file filters precede collect/load; grep, inverse test lists and onlyChanged are test filters, with changed-file detection after load. Ordinary execution performs setup/load/phases; list mode loads/reports without execution tasks. Project dependencies gate dispatch and inherit produced environment. Dispatcher prefers compatible free worker hashes, restarts incompatible/stopped workers and stops failed workers. Test groups preserve fixture/project/repeat/file/serial and all-hook constraints. This may avoid setup work but gives no measured speedup.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: Snapshot count versus retried predicate assertion
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: locator.count sends a single query and server returns 0 on retriable query errors. toHaveCount delegates to locator expectation, which performs one immediate check then retries using remaining time; the first check uses null progress. Non-array selectors are strict. Missing selectors intentionally satisfy zero count, empty arrays, hidden/detached and selected negated predicates. These prove the named predicate rather than attachment or application readiness.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: Strict click retries and actionability
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Locator click requests strict frame selection; detached handles retry and dispose. force skips page action prechecks/frame visibility and visible/enabled/stable/hit-target checks but still scrolls and computes a point. Pointer action restores modifiers, runs mouse input and conditional navigation waiting. Trial pointer mode uses injected event interception rather than simply omitting all input dispatch. Browser action outcomes were not observed.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: Native launch transport and persistence branch
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Client normalizes defaults/arguments/environment then dispatcher checks denyLaunch. Server validates options and chooses Selenium or native launch, retries one specified glibc error, creates profile/artifact directories, resolves a caller executable or registry path, and spawns with environment. Readiness races early exit before pipe/WebSocket connection. Persistent default context preparation is skipped for ignoreAllDefaultArgs; connect failures close the process. No browser started.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: Storage collection replacement and reuse cleanup
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Collection obtains cookies/optional credentials, tries live-page utility collection, then visits remaining origins through intercepted temporary pages closed in finally; opt-in IndexedDB/OPFS comes from injected collector. Client optionally writes formatted JSON and reads supplied state files. API replacement clears cache/cookies/credentials, restores union of old/new origins and closes temporary page; reuse retains first page and removes interceptor. Injected restore clears session/local storage, handles service workers with one deliberate nonawaited branch, starts IndexedDB deletion without waiting callback, restores DB/OPFS. Roundtrip test asserts actual IDB values for new-context and API-replacement paths. No saved state/certificates were accessed.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: Tool and fetch trust boundaries
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Unsafe code tool executes user function in host vm with page/fetch globals and explicit RCE-equivalent description. File checks follow symlinks with workspace/output containment but bypass code/unrestricted/skill origin. Configured web server runs shell command with inherited environment. Fetch can disable TLS verification and carries that flag across redirects, strips cross-origin Authorization, and retries Basic challenge when credentials configured. Tests assert same/cross-origin authorization outcomes; no vulnerability reproduced or actual credentials read.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: Run result transfer
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Spec statistics become public run results, after:run runs before writeOutput, and the programmatic wrapper reads the temporary JSON. Static path; no launched binary or result observed.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: Network interception request and response
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Middleware excludes component dev-server traffic and handles preflight; matching prioritizes middleware then reverse handlers. Registered request events can change buffered bodies or end transport, response subscriptions merge changes, and finish emits after:response then removes state.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: Open session persistence and CLI attachment
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Open mode writes immutable identity through serialized temporary rename. CLI validates records and PID liveness, verifies identity and CDP reachability, then chooses ready supported sessions and probes CDP targets for the tap binding. No actual attachment was attempted.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: Related selection and parallel orchestration
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Inverse dependency selection precedes filter intersection; shard/sort/failure filtering feeds scheduling. Project module maps and changed-file arrays enter worker calls and success/failure events return.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: Per-file runtime with reusable transform artifacts
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Fresh runtime/environment per file, source-backed cacheFS, transform-and-compile load path, and guarded runtime-before-environment teardown. Setup files run before later guarded framework block.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: Snapshot match, retry rollback and persistence
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Test identity follows matcher into state; retry event rolls back its recorded writes/counters/unchecked keys, with foreign writes preserving dirty state. Adapter protects failed/skipped snapshots, removes eligible unchecked keys and saves.

testing_speed_source_notes.fact: Related/changed selection uses inverse dependencies and intersects a custom filter; onlyChanged without SCM finds none. Collection runs setup and module loading before skipping bodies, reports selected entries passed plus wouldRun with zero invocations/assertions, and can report load errors. Collection success is not a passing test result; selection completeness unmeasured.

Parallel worker farm has bounded maxWorkers, idle memory limit, threads option and maxRetries=3; project resolvers retained in worker map. Each file constructs new environment/runtime; resetModules/mock cleanup inside file is conditional on config. Worker retry does not establish test correctness, and cross-file process-level state isolation is not proven by fresh runtime alone.

Project cache and disk transformed code reuse avoid repeated transformation when configured cache is enabled. Custom transformer cache keys contribute to key validity. Code checksum and atomic writes protect individual artifacts; source explicitly warns separate code/map writes can mismatch. Cache speed/correctness under this workload unmeasured.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: Root ownership rendering hydration and query scope
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Option validation precedes DOM allocation. New containers select concurrent or legacy adapter and register in Set plus array; existing containers reuse their stored root and creation callbacks. Wrapper is inside optional StrictMode. Concurrent hydration occurs once at root creation; adapter hydrate then noops, while rerender renders captured root and scope. Queries bind baseElement (container when supplied, otherwise body), whereas fragments use container HTML. Multi-base tests assert both positive and negative query isolation; this is DOM predicate proof, not browser actionability or rendering-speed measurement.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: Conditional automatic cleanup and teardown boundary
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Entry guard uses truthiness for skip flag and governs cleanup plus beforeAll/afterAll act-global hooks. Pure still configures shared DOM wrappers. cleanup unmounts every tracked root in act, removes only direct body children, clears tracking; result.unmount does not deregister stored root. Auto-cleanup tests assert body cleared next test and explicit skip preserves prior markup. Cleanup test specifically asserts no microtask flush and preservation of missing-act warning. No isolation test executed; custom parents and pending tasks require separate ownership.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: Act async wrapper fake timers and nested events
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Compatibility chooses React.act or deprecated test-utils. It sets act flag true and restores synchronously/on throw or only on consumption of async thenable. Async DOM wrapper temporarily disables flag, awaits callback, waits zero-delay timer and advances detected Jest fake timers, restores finally. Nested event wrappers bypass a second act but guard resets finally. Real/legacy/modern timer tests use synthetic promise and random macrotask loaders and assert loaded DOM; no HTTP server or scheduler-performance claim.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: React event adapters and assertion strength
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: DOM event methods copied at import then selected helpers add over/out for enter/leave, focus input and keyUp for select, focusIn/focusOut for focus/blur. Generated event-table tests assert handler call count once for React and native listeners; nested regression asserts effect/event counters and no act warnings. These checks exercise synthetic DOM dispatch, not trusted browser input or complete user interaction sequence.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: Hook committed result and configuration persistence
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Hook callback runs during TestComponent render, result ref updates in useEffect, rerender supplies new callback props and wrapper uses render pipeline. Tests assert committed effect update, props and provider values; recoverable-error hook test only passes option and TODO, does not trigger recovery. configure forwards DOM delta and always assigns extracted reactStrictMode, so omitted key changes it to undefined; config suite restores captured configuration but does not assert retention for DOM-only delta.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: Cross-version source validation and release authority
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Peer range supports React18/19; tests gate legacy APIs by React version and assert React19 rejection. Jest inherits external configuration and relaxes per-job core thresholds; workflow matrix covers Node18/24 and React18/latest/canary/experimental with non-latest continue-on-error. Codecov target is definition, no measured coverage. Separate release job depends validate, grants OIDC/write permissions, installs without lockfile and only publishes upstream push. Read workflow references only, no credential values or release execution.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: Query cardinality scoped binding and text labels
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: within binds supplied query functions to container; screen captures body availability at module load or installs throwing stubs. BuildQueries maps candidate arrays to nullable-single, required-all/single and getter-backed async variants; multiple single matches throw. Text includes matching container and descendants but reads immediate text nodes or input button values, with exact/fuzzy/custom normalization. Labels resolve native labels or scoped aria-labelledby IDs plus aria-label, deduplicate, filter selector and issue association-specific missing errors. Assertions remain DOM predicates rather than rendered-browser fidelity.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: Retry completion assertion boundary and clocks
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Find queries wrap required getter in waitFor. waitFor attempts immediately, uses real MutationObserver plus interval or fixed Jest fake-clock advancement; pending callback promise blocks repeated attempts. Any synchronous nonthrowing return including false/null/undefined, or fulfilled promise, completes successfully; thrown/rejected values retry. Timeout reports last truthy error or generated timeout, normal onDone clears timers/observer. Timer-mode switch branches reject directly, so cleanup is only a source hotspot, not reproduced failure. Fake-clock test compares >=1000ms fake elapsed with <=20ms real CPU approximation and recursive timers test prevents starvation; no measured result here.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: Removal transition versus generic absence
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Removal checks initial nonempty presence. Direct elements capture top-most-parent containment, including a detached DOM tree; later getter TestingLibraryElementError counts as removal while other exceptions retry to timeout/error. Success returns undefined. Tests assert present-to-removed transition, initial absence rejection, correct error forwarding and direct/array containment. This predicate does not necessarily prove prior attachment to document.body, and generic waitFor with nullable query can resolve immediately.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: Role candidates ordered state filters and accessibility
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Role query validates supported state options, narrows CSS candidates, matches explicit first token or fallbacks and implicit roles. Selected/busy/checked/pressed/current/expanded/level branches return in precedence, so combined states are not all conjoined; value fields conjoin only if no earlier state applies. Name/description and hidden filters follow. Per-query WeakMap caches subtree exclusion; ancestor hidden/aria-hidden/display-none plus computed element visibility apply partial accessibility semantics. ByRole candidate query excludes container itself unlike ByText. Fast retry disables expensive missing-role listings but no timing is measured.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: Event construction mutation and dispatch
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Registry defaults merge caller initialization, native/prototype setter updates value, files/property assignment occurs before event creation, and node-owned window supplies constructor or ignored legacy fallback. Transfer properties may use provided local DataTransfer constructor. eventWrapper surrounds dispatchEvent and aliases delegate registry methods. Tests assert listener calls, propagation/shadow composition, target values/files and transfer properties with simulated constructor; no trusted native input or browser drag/drop behavior established.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: Diagnostic output filesystem access and shared configuration
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Config shallow-merges module state and returns it directly; expensive-error flag resets false rather than preserving prior state. Error formatting embeds DOM; debug can read first non-node_modules stack-derived source path and print code frame without repo restriction. Playground helper compresses raw innerHTML into logged URL fragment without fetching. No secret files or generated URLs were read/opened. Tests restore config, timers and body; release workflow is separately privileged and source-only. Unescaped role/label ID selector interpolation remains correctness hypothesis without reproduction.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: HTTP handler resolution and fallthrough
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Frames read current handlers then resolve. Sequential lookup stops on a response, retains match-without-response, rechecks once usage after async parsing, and preserves generator/finalize state. Explicit bypass and unhandled CONNECT differ from the configured unhandled path; real network outcomes untested.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: Node scoped handler overrides
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Boundary creates AsyncLocalStorage context from shallow bucket copies, use prepends overrides, frame lookup reads that state, and missing async context falls back. Handler instances and mutable resolver/once/generator state are not cloned. Concurrency assertions target initial/override/initial response isolation, not universal state isolation.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: Disable, disposal and worker in-flight teardown
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Disable invokes source teardown synchronously while observing both asynchronous disposal results. Worker retains channel handling for pending traffic. Tests assert a gated pending response completes, later traffic bypasses, disposal rejections produce no observed unhandled rejection over 100ms, and abort cleanups run once. None executed.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: Selected files to isolated workers
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Selection and failure-first ordering precede provider compilation of discovered files. Each selected file gets new thread/process and Runner; provider loaders precede sequential setup modules and test import.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: Runnable completion and worker release
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Hooks gate serial/concurrent work; promises/observables complete before assertion-plan and pending-assertion checks, reverse teardown and expected-failure inversion. Snapshot/shared-worker cleanup precedes worker-finished/free-worker handshake and parent aggregation.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: Snapshot identity, retention and paired artifacts
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Snapshot title/index follows assertion to descriptor comparison or recording; skipped blocks/snapshots retain prior data. Save separately atomically writes snapshot/report; updating discards decode errors. Pair inconsistency is an unexecuted hypothesis, not reproduced.

testing_speed_source_notes.fact: Watch dependency tracing selects known dependents and reruns all on unknown non-test changes. Tracer cache can reuse but retraces all tests after changes; exact imports only, installed dependencies ignored, config modules not reloaded. Provider compilation receives all discovered tests even when selection is narrow. Selection speed/completeness unmeasured.

Fresh file workers instead of general worker pool reuse. File concurrency defaults CPU count min1, explicit serial1, automatic CI2; within-file concurrent tests already started are not cancelled by fail-fast. Failed-file cache reorders all selected files, disabled in CI/cache-off, not successful-test skipping. Worker modes inherit parent environment; speed/state isolation unmeasured.

No-assertion failure defaults enabled; explicit plan zero can intentionally pass with zero assertions. Pending assertions/attempts flagged and expected-failing inverts outcome. These guards do not prove acceptance relevance; CI watch suite serialized and reporter suites Linux-only. All test definitions inspected, not executed.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: File selection loading and post-load grep
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: CLI serial path collects files using spec/ignore before absolute resolution and preserves --file precedence; serial awaits sequential loader with pre/require/post events. Loader branches on Node require_module feature, .mjs import and error-specific fallback, rejects non-file URL protocols. Runner applies title grep after files/module declarations loaded, counts matching suites then skips unmatched bodies, yielding to avoid deep recursive skipping. Parallel path defers module loading to workers. File filtering can avoid loading work; grep does not prove that saving. No runtime speed measured.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: Runnable completion hooks retry and global fixtures
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Runnable accepts nonthrowing synchronous body or fulfilled promise as success without checking assertion count/truthiness; callback mode validates errors and checks overspecified callback+promise after returned result is available; synchronous done can occur before result assignment, repeated completion emits error. Timer completion/elapsed timeout and falsy rejection are handled. Runner hooks surround tests; retries clone/requeue before afterEach without final failure count, exhausted failure emits fail. Mocha returns Runner synchronously; setup error returns one failure, teardown error adds one, reporter.done controls completion callback. CLI passOnFailingTestSuite can override code to zero; completion is not task correctness.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: Pooled child reuse serialized options and file lifecycle
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Pool explicitly uses child processes with inherited Node flags and environment plus per-process ID; each worker bootstraps requires/UI/root hooks once, excluding global setup/teardown, then creates new Mocha per file. Options WeakMap avoids repeated serialization by identity and omits functions, unsafe serialized string is evaluated in trusted worker. Worker removes all uncaughtException/unhandledRejection listeners on successful run callback and returns serialized buffered outcome. Fresh Mocha is not fresh process/module/global state. Unit tests stub pool/Mocha and assert serialization/initialization once; no process reuse benchmark or module-isolation proof.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: Buffered replay bail crashes and receipt completeness
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Parent queues files concurrently with allSettled, replays full buffered events after file result, optionally links shared event objects, accumulates failures and terminates pool. Bail lets completed file cleanup/replay finish then gracefully terminates and ignores later outcomes; allowUncaught forces termination. A crashing worker can lose earlier pass events before flush; integration explicitly asserts only surviving file pass and crashing file attribution. Buffered reporting does not provide complete live per-test event evidence after crash.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: Reuse state module cache and watcher reconstruction
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Guard rejects overlapping runs and disposed/reference-cleaned instance reuse; run cleans previous runner/reset suite when allowed. loadFilesAsync uses Node module caches; unloadFiles deletes listed direct require-cache entries and explicitly cannot clear ESM cache. Watch serial rebuild unloads, clones root, disposes old instance, creates new context and rebinds UI/root hooks. This manages some runner/listener state but does not establish a clean dependency graph or complete global resource cleanup.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: Reporter persistence browser assertion and costly diffs
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Stats come from lifecycle events; JSON reporter stores result then synchronously creates directories/writes selected output, falls back stdout on write error; no root confinement. Browser fixture publishes counts/failures on window and Chromium Playwright tests assert failures zero and total positive, not all browser engines. Diff protection tests time large buffers/deep repeated objects/many keys <1000ms and assert string conversion; small-object test only absence of fallback phrase. No timing or passing browser proof from this investigation.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: Spec selection, hook queue and cleanup
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Runner chooses IDs/focus/top suite and seeded order/filter; TreeRunner sets runnable resources and assembles hooks/spec/cleanup, omits user callbacks when pending/excluded, and clears resources before awaiting specDone. Queue invokes callbacks in host context and distinguishes thenable versus done style; no isolation sandbox or real scheduling observation.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: Async expectation result and late reporting
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: expectAsync binds the current runnable, comparison returns a promise and records result, and a changed current runnable also causes a top-suite late-expectation failure. If all results were already reported, late failure route logs. Reporter event payloads are cloned per recipient; no result was executed.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: Repeat execution and parallel batch reset
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Default closure cleanup clears spec functions, so retained-suite repeat runs need autoCleanClosures false. parallelReset removes prior children and resets runner execution state; tests assert new-batch results and retained top hooks. External jasmine/parallel owns worker implementation; this checkout configures count but does not prove process/worker isolation or performance.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: Equality to assertion error
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Input target/comparator flags enter strict or deep comparison, negation evaluates truthiness, failed assertion produces actual/expected/diff metadata and formatted message; successful undefined result continues through transferred flags.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: Property chain target replacement

bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Command validates options and supplies selected extras/groups. Installer update solves candidates; locked mode rejects stale input and may re-resolve older formats. Transaction applies groups/markers/extras and compares installed metadata, then installer validates path operations and executes; root editable build is a later separate phase.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: Constraint resolution and transitive metadata
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Puzzle Solver enters use-latest context, delegates to version solver, handles override requests and wraps resolution failures. Version loop propagates incompatibilities and chooses versions; conflict handling inspects satisfier levels. Result markers are simplified before Transaction. Exhaustiveness and solver performance were not measured.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: Artifact preparation, conditional hashes and wheel mutation
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Source-specific preparation returns wheel artifact; cached original archive supplies conditional package.files hash verification. Unknown filename or mismatch fails when hashes exist. Non-wheels invoke ephemeral backend builds; update removes previous distribution before installing wheel. Destination checks containment, permits warned overwrites, and RECORD content validation is disabled. Build environment isolation does not establish sandbox security.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: Success and failure persistence boundaries
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Dependency success precedes updated lock write; add then writes project TOML only on zero status and non-dry mode. Install root build occurs after dependency phase and can independently fail. Lock rewrite opens the destination directly; uninstaller documents no rollback. Interrupted partial state remains an unexecuted hypothesis.

testing_speed_source_notes.topic: Parallel test configuration and integration selection
testing_speed_source_notes.fact: Pytest defaults to logical-CPU xdist workers. Unless --integration is supplied, configure appends not integration to any existing mark expression. Actual parallel efficiency and speed were not measured.

Fixtures isolate config directories/environment, mock Git cloning by default and clear direct-Git cache. Session fixtures reuse metadata/current interpreter and a temporary working directory; tmp_venv creates and deletes a virtual environment per requested test. Isolation strength and setup latency were not measured.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: Environment preparation and dependency persistence
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Runner yields command context before prepare/execute, checking compatibility only for missing environments. New environment resets metadata, creates and conditionally runs install hooks/project install. Dependency hash compares persisted value; locked inputs may generate lock, changed state checks/synchronizes dependencies and persists hash. Creation errors remove unless keep_env. bounded_source_flow_notes.name: Hatchling artifact and hook order
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Frontend invokes python -m hatchling after build environment preparation. Backend selects target builder, validates metadata and versions, initializes hooks before artifact call and finalizes after. Wheel streams files with SHA256/size records, writes metadata/RECORD then replaces archive destination. Sample test asserts selected files and one fixed WHEEL timestamp, not full reproducibility.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: Alternative backend subprocess and JSON handoff

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: Install selection, resolution and dry-run boundary
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Command applies external-environment guard conditions, builds resolver and resolves under 200000-round ceiling. bounded_source_flow_notes.name: Metadata, cached origin hashes and source backend preparation

bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Add registers state; flush gathers work, registers dependency actions and handles cycles by per-state actions, then persistence splits insert/update. bounded_source_flow_notes.name: typed query to PostgreSQL cursor and row conversion
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: load collects fallible decoded rows; get_result selects the first. LoadIter.count delegates directly to the underlying cursor and does not invoke build_from_row, so a count alone does not establish successful deserialization.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: SQL generation, bind collection and prepared statement identity
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: SQL and bind serialization use separate AST passes. Safe queries use type identity or SQL plus bind metadata; occupied entries reuse statements, successful vacant preparation registers them, unsafe queries prepare uncached. bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Bind size/count conversion checks precede unsafe FFI; named and unnamed execution branches differ. execute_returning_count drains remaining results before updating transaction status. This is ownership/bounds inspection, not libpq qualification.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: transaction, savepoint and rollback-result boundary
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Manager begin/commit/rollback operate on depth and savepoints; rollback failures can supersede the callback error and mark manager broken. test_transaction discards the outer transaction Result and returns captured callback success; its ordinary-path test separately asserts post-rollback row count zero. bounded_source_flow_notes.name: CLI startup and configuration precedence
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Tracing and optional dotenv loading precede Clap parsing. URL/config/migration precedence is explicit; only public source adapters were read, no environment values or dotenv files.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: database setup and destructive reset boundary
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Setup creates directory/config/database as needed and runs migrations. Reset invokes drop before setup; SQLite removes the supplied existing file and server branches issue database drop. Commands were never executed.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: migration pending order, execution and bookkeeping
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Pending versions are filtered and sorted; each migration executes then tracks its version under its own metadata-controlled transaction, not one enclosing batch transaction. Invalid/missing metadata falls back to default transaction enabled. SQL file read errors and empty files are reported.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: schema resolver, formatting, patch and locked output
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Resolver caches catalog data and detects recursive relation chains. Formatting failure warns and exports unformatted source; patches are applied after formatting. Locked mode compares lines after prior migrations, without enclosing migration rollback; output paths are operational trust inputs.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: example ownership selection and update target
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Auth verifies stored Argon2 hashes; registration explicitly warns about its constant example salt. EditPost updates its selected record while EditComment uses the unfiltered comments table after a scoped read. Source-level target mismatch, no exploit reproduction.
