bounded_source_flow_notes.name: test database and migration setup isolation
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Integration helpers establish fresh connections and usually begin test transactions. SQLite uses separate in-memory databases and migrates each; non-SQLite migration setup uses process-local Once. Test-transaction pooling is explicitly exempted from the open-transaction broken check; not evidence of isolation across all parallel workers.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: test orchestration, selection and session reuse
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: xtask performs migrations before native integration tests, forwards filters, serializes MySQL/MariaDB native tests, and chooses cargo test for WASM. The source comment explains one Node translation session versus a Node process per nextest test. CLI group caps concurrency at eight; two identified flaky tests have retries. CI declarations and intended optimization were inspected, never measured.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: diagnostics, snapshots and conditional schema compilation assertions
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: ui_test checks expected diagnostics unless BLESS presence selects output rewriting; macro snapshots check generated syntax text. Schema snapshots compile only when check_compile is true, reusing a selected target directory with offline Cargo checks and explicit status handling. Migration CLI test checks exit, output and database table state. perf_details checks layout, not measured throughput.

verification_findings.topic: test session reuse and backend concurrency
verification_findings.finding: WASM selects cargo test rather than nextest, with an explicit comment about one Node session and translation instead of one per test. Native MySQL/MariaDB nextest runs are serialized, CLI group concurrency is eight, and two selected tests retry twice. These are source-declared choices, not measured speedups or demonstrated flake elimination.

verification_findings.topic: build reuse and precise schema assertion boundary
verification_findings.finding: Schema compilation shares a selected target directory and runs Cargo offline; snapshots always check rendered text, while check_compile=false skips the compile assertion. Macro snapshots do not execute a database. BLESS presence rewrites diagnostic expectations instead of requiring unchanged expectations.

test_transaction discards the outer transaction Result and returns captured callback success. Its separate ordinary-path test checks post-rollback count zero. A returned callback value alone does not establish successful rollback; no rollback-failure defect was reproduced.

verification_findings.topic: row count is not deserialization qualification
verification_findings.finding: LoadIter.next builds each row, but its count override delegates directly to the cursor. A count-only check therefore bypasses row conversion and is weaker than collecting fallible decoded rows. The perf_details suite checks memory layout, not timing.

verification_findings.topic: statement cache scope and authorizer invalidation
verification_findings.finding: The default statement cache is unbounded for a connection lifetime; unsafe fragments prepare uncached. Instrumentation tests count cache insertions, not all executions or elapsed time. Both installing and removing a SQLite authorizer explicitly clear Diesel statement cache despite nearby stale comments about SQLite expiration.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: ActiveModel write state, save branching and returned model
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: ActiveValue controls included columns; save chooses insertion when primary keys are incomplete, otherwise update. Before/after hooks bracket persistence. Insert uses RETURNING when supported, otherwise lookup by inserted key; missing returned model errors. Builder lowers backend statements and PostgreSQL binds values separately; row conversion errors propagate. Vendor transport behavior was not executed.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: Generated nested save transaction and parent ordering
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Generated Save action starts transaction, invokes prerequisite relation actions, writes changed or genuinely new parent, invokes subsequent relation actions and commits. Unchanged existing scalar parent is skipped. Relation state documentation distinguishes append and replace, but internal relation macro cleanup and all rollback paths were not independently inspected.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: RBAC engine mount, statement audit and permission forwarding
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Load replaces mounted engine and restricted_for clones connection with user identity. Connection and transaction bridge user checks to shared mount. Raw SQL methods reject; structured requests audit action/schema/table and require every request permitted before forwarding. Engine checks user override then role grants and wildcard paths. Optional wrapper bypass by ordinary retained handles remains an application integration hypothesis, not a proven vulnerability.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: Runtime assembly and task scheduling
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Builder selects current/multithread scheduler, constructs drivers/blocking pool, and launches workers for threaded mode. block_on enters runtime and drives root future. Spawn binds owned task/ID then schedules locally in same worker or injects remotely; yield favors queue back. This is not fairness or latency measurement.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: TCP bind and readiness-driven acceptance
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Bind resolves addresses and sequentially attempts Mio sockets, registering selected listener. Accept awaits readable readiness and cooperative budget; WouldBlock clears readiness and retries. New accepted stream assumes read/write readiness for initial operation. Loopback echo assertions are definitions, not observed network execution.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: Filesystem dispatch and buffered completion
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Whole-file write probes gated io-uring support or moves owned inputs into spawn_blocking std::fs::write. File poll_write copies bytes and returns while blocking work is Busy; flush joins Busy operation and propagates write result; sync_all completes in-flight work then asks underlying filesystem to synchronize.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: Bounded channel permit and closure ownership
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Send reserves channel capacity then consumes permit to publish; unused permit drop returns capacity and may wake closed receiver. Receive returns capacity on pop, registers waker and checks again to address race; closed-and-idle produces None. Wrapper forwards polling. Tests specify close/permit-drop wakeup behavior without execution.

testing_speed_source_notes.fact: Pause requires current-thread runtime; idle paused clock can auto-advance except when inhibited by blocking work. Explicit advance jumps once then yields, does not await every expired timer and permits arbitrary polling order. Seeded stress test compares two simulated sequences; wall-clock speed and real scheduling behavior remain unmeasured.

CI uses nextest for workspace tests and separate cargo test --doc; it repeats companion tests without local patches. cargo-hack feature powerset check is depth two, so it does not enumerate every feature combination. Definitions establish no passing results or measured gains.

testing_speed_source_notes.fact: Loom job caps preemptions at two and branches at 10000 and conditionally selects scheduler groups by PR labels. Racy shutdown scenario covers blocking core handoff with pool drop, but this bounded model is not exhaustive concurrency proof and was not executed.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: connection acceptance and service creation
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Accept precedes make_service readiness and per-connection service creation, Hyper adaptation, then executor task creation. Connection semaphore permit stays owned with IO; connection limits differ from request concurrency. HTTP/1 timer is installed in Hyper builder; no listener or transport ran.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: path metadata and method dispatch
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: PathRouter sets optional original/matched URI metadata and decoded captures, then chooses endpoint. HEAD chooses explicit HEAD then GET; fallback carries Allow metadata. Top-level response future inserts length before removing HEAD body. Missing path delegates to catch-all fallback.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: ordered extractor rejection and JSON consumption
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Parts extractors precede the sole final request extractor; each rejection short-circuits handler invocation. JSON content type precedes limited byte collection and typed deserialization, with trailing input rejected through end(). Default body size is extractor-local, not an unconditional global server limit.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: state and middleware continuation
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: with_state installs cloned supplied state and State uses FromRef. Router.layer wraps existing routes; route_layer differs for fallback. FromFn transfers ready inner service into Next, which calls remaining stack; HandleError converts service error into response. Layer ordering is a source-composition constraint, not measured middleware behavior.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: key-value application writes and reads
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Example owns Arc/RwLock map, applies compression only to GET, disables default limit for POST while setting separate 5120000-byte request limit, and writes body bytes by key. Reads clone stored bytes or return 404. This is in-memory application state, no durable framework store established.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: JWT demonstration authenticate and protected extraction
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Routes wire fixed demonstration authorization into encode and bearer extraction into decode with Validation::default. Lazy key initialization reads required configuration and can panic. Public source adapters inspected only; no environment values, tokens, actual credential data or dependency cryptographic behavior inspected.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: OAuth CSRF session exchange ordering
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Initiation stores CSRF and redirects with cookie flags; callback loads and destroys old session before comparing state, then exchanges code and fetches user into new session. User extractor has panic/unwrap branches for unexpected failures. Demonstration MemoryStore warning is explicit; no live OAuth, session validity or security qualification established.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: Diesel application startup migrations and action
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Pool initialization and embedded migration run precede listener binding. Insert/list operations use interact closure and nested results, with internal errors converted to strings in HTTP 500 responses. No database connection, migration or dependency execution occurred.

bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Direct Request handler streams without extractor-local limit. Multipart uses limited body, but next_field errors terminate the while-let and return normal redirect. Filename validation rejects multiple/non-normal components before File.create; this does not establish symlink containment or overwrite safety at runtime.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: graceful drain and connection age deadline
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Signal closure stops acceptance and initiates tracked connection graceful shutdown; server waits for close receivers to disappear. Age plus jitter starts when connection task starts, then optional grace force closes. Drain test holds handler through Notify and checks pending server, response status/body, final timeout. HTTP/1 upgraded sockets leave this tracking according to documented boundary.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: private cookies and response updates
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Key derives from supplied state; only cookies for which dependency decrypt returns Some are retained as originals. IntoResponseParts writes jar changes to headers. No actual key/cookie inspected, and cryptographic library internals not independently qualified.

bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: HEAD tests intentionally use oneshot because reqwest strips HEAD bodies, checking server-level body semantics directly. TestClient binds ephemeral loopback and retains one reqwest client; WebSocket example separately tests transport echo and channel-based handler echo. MockConnectInfo can support socket-free focused tests; paused time and duplex test protocol handling without an OS socket.

bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: AXUM_TEST_ONLY narrows a pass/fail fixture and skips unrelated directory. Nightly harness runs trybuild; stable/beta harness is empty. debug_handler checks emit only under debug_assertions. Internal test macro duplicates matching nest calls into nest_service variant. These are intended coverage gates, not evidence tests passed.

verification_findings.finding: HEAD tests explicitly avoid reqwest because it strips HEAD bodies. oneshot assertions check headers and collected empty server body directly; transport tests cover a different boundary. TestClient binds ephemeral loopback and reuses one client per instance. No overhead or speedup measured.

In-process Router.oneshot checks routing; MockConnectInfo substitutes connection metadata where absent. WebSocket example separately checks one echo over transport and one over channels. verification_findings.finding: Paused Tokio time with duplex IO checks stalled-header closure without OS network. Drain test waits for handler start, signals shutdown, asserts server pending, releases handler, checks status/body and final server completion. Age/grace test holds never-completing handler and separately expects request failure plus server completion. No test executed.

verification_findings.finding: AXUM_TEST_ONLY narrows trybuild pass/fail fixtures and returns for unrelated directories. Nightly only runs the harness; other toolchains run an empty branch. debug_handler emits compile checks only under debug_assertions. CI registration alone is not passing diagnostics evidence.

verification_findings.topic: benchmark process boundary and duration intent
verification_findings.finding: Benchmark name filtering occurs before router and runtime creation. Each selected benchmark creates a new runtime and server thread, then launches rewrk with ten connections/threads; configured duration is one second on CI versus ten locally. Harness checks process exit, not response correctness or statistically robust performance. No benchmark/tool installation executed.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: Request reuse, ordered routing and JSON extraction
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Pooled request resets routing state; ordered router captures path only after predicate acceptance. Resource selects first passing route and default405, application default404. Handler awaits extractor, converts error before invocation, otherwise calls/responds. JSON payload is consumed/decompressed, declared and accumulated sizes checked before deserialize; configured error handler can transform error. Middleware and complete protocol decoder were not inspected.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: Multipart field budgets and temporary storage
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Form validates form-data, keeps shared remaining budgets by repeated name, delegates each field and reconstructs collected type. TempFile consumes total/field budgets before chunk write and flush; not memory budget. Discard drain also accounts bytes. Sample handler returns metadata without durable promotion. Custom readers must uphold budget contract; filesystem retention/error cleanup was not executed.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: Outbound JSON and redirected request rebuilding
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Serializer sets content-type only when absent; sender boxes body and chooses per-request timeout before client timeout. Positive redirect budget installs transform; Location target rebuild decrements budget. 301/302/303 preserve GET/HEAD otherwise GET, remove body; 307/308 preserve method and reusable bytes but nonreusable stream becomes empty. Host/port/scheme change removes credential headers. Connector/pool internals and live destinations were not verified.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: Route chain construction, pooled dispatch and misses
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Group registration copies combined middleware into route chain; dispatch obtains/reset context, selects method/path tree, installs params/fullPath and runs Next before header commitment and normal pool return. Abort skips pending handlers without returning from current handler. Misses consider redirects, optional allowed-method search and error chains.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: JSON binding, validation and response commitment
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Automatic binding selects Form for GET or content-type binder; JSON decodes with configured policies then validator binding tags. ShouldBind returns errors, MustBind aborts and commits 400/413 according to propagated error. Cached body binding reads whole input once. Render stages status and aborts on error without replacement status; response body write commits headers.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: Multipart upload and caller-selected persistence
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Multipart parse uses configured memory threshold; FormFile closes initial opened handle. SaveUploadedFile reopens upload, creates parent directories and chmods only newly absent destination directory, then creates/truncates caller path and copies bytes. Existing-directory permission regression is asserted but unexecuted; no root confinement appears in helper.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: Forwarded identity, recovery and copy lifetime
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Default trusts all CIDRs; TrustedPlatform header precedes peer-CIDR checks, otherwise forwarded chain is parsed right-to-left. Recovery catches nested handler panic, distinguishes broken connections and masks only Authorization in dumps. Context copy detaches underlying writer but retains Request and shallow key values; route insertion is explicitly not concurrent-safe.

testing_speed_source_notes.topic: Package selection and test-result propagation limit
testing_speed_source_notes.fact: Make test loops packages ending gin/ginS/binding/render serially, excluding existing internal/fs tests. It scans stdout for selected failure strings rather than directly propagating each go test exit status; failures without those strings are an unexecuted check-result concern. CI invokes this Make target. No test execution or speed measured.

Matrix separates default, nomsgpack, sonic, go_json and race runs on Ubuntu/macOS Go 1.26/1.27. It caches build/module directories by OS/go.sum with OS fallback. This is reuse configuration, not observed cache hits, cached passing tests or measured latency.

RunQUIC case starts QUIC, waits five milliseconds and uses helper constructed with http.Transport to check HTTPS output. That helper does not establish an HTTP/3 client round trip. Test runtime and result were not observed.

Request-size test supplies MaxBytesReader and expects codec-dependent 400 versus 413; custom-codec test restores global json.API. Recovery tests check Authorization casing but not Cookie/Proxy-Authorization masking. These definitions neither establish passing status nor all-variant coverage.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: Compiled dispatch and context lifetime
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: ServeHTTP borrows/resets a Context, runs the pre-chain to resolve routing then the global chain, delegates errors, and returns the Context to the pool. Backwards middleware compilation makes earlier registrations outermost. Reset clears store values while retaining reusable allocation; references must not escape request lifetime.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: Route parsing, middleware and reversal
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Group registration copies middleware into a prefixed Route. Add compiles route middleware and parses static/parameter/wildcard nodes into one method-bearing tree. Registration and Reverse share walkRoutePath, including escaped-colon/inline-verb syntax; reversal is not HTTP dispatch.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: Binding precedence and metadata reuse
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Default binding applies path values, selected-method query values, then body; headers use a separate entry point. Reflection metadata caches tags by type, not request values. Generic helpers explicitly distinguish an absent path/query entry.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: Buffered JSON decode and test boundary
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Deserialize buffers the full body and unmarshals one JSON value; 64 KiB controls pooled buffer retention, not admission. Tests assert trailing-data rejection, decoded values across alternating sizes/concurrent goroutines, and read-error status. Tests do not establish which sync.Pool object was reused.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: Delayed JSON response and centralized errors
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: JSON delays status commitment while serializing. The default error handler exits for committed Echo responses. RequestLogger default HandleError invokes that handler before outer middleware returns; a later returned error cannot replace committed output.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: Static filesystem validation and regression scope
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: StaticDirectoryHandler validates paths before optional unescaping and resolves the filesystem/directory redirects. fsFile opens index files and requires ReadSeeker before ServeContent. Encoded-separator fixtures assert status and no protected content, providing finite coverage rather than arbitrary filesystem safety proof.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: Startup and graceful shutdown
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Start installs handler/read timeout, creates/uses a listener, calls BeforeServe and waits for the graceful goroutine. Cancellation invokes Shutdown with a configured/default deadline and an error callback/logger. Tests assert response bodies, shutdown errors and refused subsequent connections; deadline expiration is not evidence of forcibly terminating a handler.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: Body limits, timeout and diagnostic replacement
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: BodyLimit checks declared length and wraps reads; ContextTimeout calls next synchronously with a request deadline. BodyDump limits capture, drains remaining input, then replaces downstream input with captured bytes. Its request cap can truncate the handler-visible body, not just diagnostics.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: Proxy retry and raw upgrade lifetime
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Proxy refreshes the request after balancer selection and forwards through configured HTTP transport/response hooks with retries. Raw upgrade starts two io.Copy directions and waits for both before deferred closes. Asymmetric half-close delay is a source hypothesis; normal WebSocket echo coverage does not reproduce it.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: Rate decisions and process-local visitors
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Middleware prefers AllowContext, then routes rejection through its denial handler. Memory store locks visitor lookup/create and cleanup and performs token-bucket decisions. Tests assert selected headers/status sequences, not distributed enforcement or precise retry durations.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: Router lock and metadata boundary
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: ConcurrentRouter protects router reads/writes and clones metadata. The bounded test exercises concurrent registration/reads. This does not protect every Echo field or make retained pooled Context references safe.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: Direct handler fixtures and dispatch assertions
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: echotest initializes Context route metadata and invokes the supplied handler directly with error handling. Global pre/use/routing dispatch needs ServeHTTP. Nested JSON tests assert no error/status; reset JSON also asserts body equality, so their assertion boundaries differ.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: Benchmark reuse and CI comparison boundary
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: benchServe reuses requests/no-op writer and resets timing after setup; writer discards response status/body. CI restores build/module caches by runner/Go/job and compares base/current PR benchmarks with eight 100 ms samples. Advisory benchstat and caching configuration do not establish measured speedups or response correctness.

verification_findings.finding: benchServe reuses one request and a writer whose WriteHeader and Write discard output. Setup occurs before ResetTimer. This bounds benchmark work to the implemented framework path and excludes response buffering/transport; it does not assert response correctness or establish a measured improvement.

verification_findings.topic: CI cache reuse and advisory comparison
verification_findings.finding: CI explicitly restores build/module caches using OS, architecture, Go version and job prefixes, then PR benchmark comparison uses base/current checkouts with eight 100 ms samples. Configured caching is static intent; neither cache hit rate nor runtime savings were measured. Benchstat comparison is advisory.

echotest ServeWithHandler invokes handler(c) directly after route metadata initialization and then handles errors; it does not execute Echo.ServeHTTP routing/global middleware. Separate ServeHTTP fallback tests assert pre/use execution. Nested JSON test asserts status/no error while reset JSON also checks the body.

JSON tests verify decoded values across long/short inputs, 64 goroutines and a large-body follow-up; they do not prove specific sync.Pool reuse. Shutdown tests inspect response body/error and later connection refusal, with time-based coordination. Source calls Shutdown and reports its deadline error without a subsequent forced Close; a timeout is not proof of handler termination.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: request dispatch and pooled context release
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Acquire/reset precedes route selection; Next advances handlers or scanning; method mismatch produces Allow/405; errors precede deferred release. SkipUnmatchedRoutes can answer before middleware except preflight.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: body decoding and response encoding
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Body selects custom MIME binder before JSON. Configured decoder fills caller destination; validation is optional and requires StructValidator. Automatic error handling sets400 but requires explicit handler return; response encoder bytes become raw body.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: session load, downstream execution and persistence
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Missing stored ID generates a new token; copied storage bytes decode with gob. Middleware runs downstream then saves unless destroyed, and always releases session/middleware. Unchanged data rewrites snapshot to slide timeout. Storage receives DefaultCtx without cancellation propagation.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: outbound hooks, transport and cancellation
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: User hooks run outside client lock; builtin serialization remains locked; optional retry/redirect wraps transport. Cancellation returns early and drains eventual response/error asynchronously. Channel test checks hook concurrency without qualifying full network throughput.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: timed-out context ownership and reclamation
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: DefaultCtx is abandoned and reclaimed only after handlerDone and release signal. A handler that never finishes prevents reclaim by design. Custom Ctx fallback is abandoned and stays outside pool. Tests assert both event orderings and one cancellation but were not executed.

testing_speed_source_notes.topic: in-memory HTTP tests and timeout limits
testing_speed_source_notes.fact: App.Test serializes HTTP into an in-memory connection and runs ServeConn without a listener. Provided TestConfig replaces defaults; Timeout0 waits indefinitely. FailOnTimeout closes the connection, not evidence of handler cancellation; false grants another second. In-memory deadlines are no-ops. Tests assert response or deadline error, not complete transport/handler cleanup. Speed and real-network parity unmeasured.

testing_speed_source_notes.topic: selection, repeat jobs and result reuse
testing_speed_source_notes.fact: Benchmark command separates -bench selection from ordinary tests via -run. Normal tests use race/count1/shuffle; count1 disables test-result caching. Repeated CI declares three jobs, each count5/shuffle, sampling three process orders per source comment. The claimed one-third speed is author intent, not measured evidence here; build/session reuse not established. Org gotestsum action is referenced at main and was not inspected.

Parallel tests are preferred except AllocsPerRun. Reclaim tests check both event orders and cancellation, and hook concurrency test uses channels; these local assertions do not prove every context race or throughput. Token68 fuzz has a reference assertion, Accept parsing fuzz only invokes parser. Shown CI does not request sustained fuzz; coverage config omits generated/internal/docs files. All static and unexecuted.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: Command resolution, parse and gated lifecycle
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: ExecuteC supplies context, routes child invocation to root, initializes help/completion, chooses Find or Traverse and invokes selected command. Parse merges persistent flags. Help/version/nonrunnable return before initializers/finalizer deferral. Runnable path validates args before prehooks, then required/groups before action; error callbacks win. RunE failure skips command posthooks but deferred globals remain installed. Persistent traversal switches ancestor ordering. Platform hook internals and pflag implementation remain unverified.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: Completion argument isolation, callback selection and wire protocol
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Hidden completion command is retained only for actual invocation. Resolver copies all but incomplete token to prevent append from mutating caller backing array, resolves target without target execute, parses flags and suppresses help/version. Annotations or static ValidArgs can return before callbacks; callbacks read registry under RWMutex. Output strips disabled help/descriptions, embedded newlines and whitespace, ends with numeric directive; diagnostic goes stderr. Shell-script eval safety is outside this trace.

bounded_source_flow_notes.name: Recursive Markdown file output and mutable renderer state
bounded_source_flow_notes.finding: Tree writes available descendants before parent to caller directory using path name, os.Create, prefix and buffered renderer. First error returns without rollback of earlier files; os.Create can overwrite. Renderer initializes help state and redirects flag output; it is not pure observation. Man tree copies header before rendering. Deferred close errors, caller path policy and full generator outputs were not runtime verified.
